name: coder
description: Coder keeps a project's .coder/ design documents honest: list reports illegal, missing, and malformed documents and verifies the lock hash, lock/unlock manage the lock, update replaces design files through the review flow, and render turns them into a design.html page with Mermaid diagrams.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check src/docs.js && node --check src/glob.js && node --check src/git.js && node --check src/lock.js && node --check src/render.js && node --check src/tools/list.js && node --check src/tools/lock.js && node --check src/tools/render.js && node --check src/tools/root.js && node --check src/tools/update.js
